headline: Slovakia will abolish the transaction tax for businesses from January 2027
summary: Slovakia's Ministry of Finance will prepare a plan to abolish the transaction tax on banking operations for the republic from January 2027. The tax applies to businesses.
why: Transaction taxes on banking operations raise costs for businesses and banks, so removing them changes fiscal revenue and corporate costs in Slovakia.

original_headline: Словакия с января 2027 года отменит налог на транзакции для бизнеса
